description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

Inline media loads faster:
- Comments no longer wait for other comments' images or videos. A placeholder box shows until the media arrives.
- Media is cached on disk, so threads you've already opened show it straight away, even after restarting the app.
- Smaller downloads for Giphy and large imgur album images.
- http:// image links now load.
